import requests, sys, uuid, time, json

BASE = '{{TESTVDB_DB_URL}}'
HEADERS = {'Authorization': '{{TESTVDB_AUTH_HEADER}}', 'Content-Type': 'application/json'}

# Unique collection name
c = 'search_vis_' + uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]

print(f"=== Test: data_visibility on /v2/vectordb/entities/search ===")
print(f"Collection: {c}")

# STEP 1: Create collection
body = {
    "collectionName": c,
    "schema": {
        "autoID": False,
        "enableDynamicField": True,
        "fields": [
            {"fieldName": "id", "dataType": "Int64", "isPrimary": True},
            {"fieldName": "vector", "dataType": "FloatVector", "elementTypeParams": {"dim": 4}}
        ]
    },
    "indexParams": [
        {"fieldName": "vector", "metricType": "COSINE", "indexType": "AUTOINDEX"}
    ],
    "params": {"shardsNum": 1}
}
r = requests.post(f'{BASE}/v2/vectordb/collections/create', headers=HEADERS, json=body)
print(f"Create collection: {r.status_code} {r.json()}")
assert r.json().get('code') == 0, f"Create failed: {r.text}"
time.sleep(0.5)

# STEP 2: Insert 5 entities
entities = {
    "collectionName": c,
    "data": [
        {"id": 1, "vector": [0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.4]},
        {"id": 2, "vector": [0.2, 0.3, 0.4, 0.5]},
        {"id": 3, "vector": [0.3, 0.4, 0.5, 0.6]},
        {"id": 4, "vector": [0.4, 0.5, 0.6, 0.7]},
        {"id": 5, "vector": [0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 0.8]}
    ]
}
r = requests.post(f'{BASE}/v2/vectordb/entities/insert', headers=HEADERS, json=entities)
print(f"Insert: {r.status_code} {r.json()}")
assert r.json().get('code') == 0, f"Insert failed: {r.text}"
time.sleep(0.3)

# STEP 3: Load collection
r = requests.post(f'{BASE}/v2/vectordb/collections/load', headers=HEADERS, json={"collectionName": c})
print(f"Load: {r.status_code} {r.json()}")
assert r.json().get('code') == 0, f"Load failed: {r.text}"
